calibration_toolbox.logger_setup.configure_logger

calibration_toolbox.logger_setup.configure_logger(level='WARNING')[source]

Performs a very basic logging configuration for the package logger, which will output to sys.stderr.

The level can be set to ‘CRITICAL’, ‘ERROR’, ‘WARNING’ or ‘INFO’, which correspond to the levels in the py:mod:.logging module.

Parameters

level (str) – Which logging level should be used.

Raises

TypeError – If the type of level is not a string.

Return type

None
